description: React component for a multi-step form modal to make MCP servers public, including server selection, confirmation, and API call handling.

classes.name: MakeMCPPublicForm
classes.description: React functional component implementing a multi-step modal form for making MCP servers public.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Resets form state and closes the modal.

methods.name: handleNext
methods.description: Advances to the next step if at least one server is selected.

methods.name: handleServerSelection
methods.description: Updates selected servers based on checkbox toggle.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Submits selected servers to API to make them public, with success/error handling.

methods.name: renderStepContent
methods.description: Chooses which step content to render based on current step.

methods.name: renderStepButtons
methods.description: Renders navigation buttons for the steps.
